name: Todo Coredash
summary: Manage a user's daily to-do list through a secure internal gateway.
description: Lets the assistant list the day's tasks, review what is unfinished, and mark tasks as checked through an internal gateway API. Calls go through **Curl Request** against the configured `GATEWAY_HOST`.
readWhen: asked about tasks of the day
asked about unchecked tasks of the day

pt-br.summary: Gerencie a lista de tarefas do dia do usuário através de um gateway interno seguro.
pt-br.description: Permite que o assistente liste as tarefas do dia, revise o que ficou pendente e marque tarefas como concluídas por meio de uma API de gateway interna. As chamadas passam pelo **Curl Request** contra o `GATEWAY_HOST` configurado.
